===·export·===
Write·the·records·of·one·scope·as·one·document

Usage:·provenance·export·[OPTIONS]

Options:
······--quiet············Drop·the·advisory·notes·commands·print·alongside·their·output,·such·as·the·warning·that·this·repository·has·no·shaping·skills·installed
······--repo·<REPO>······[default:·.]
······--scope·<SCOPE>····[default:·default]
······--format·<FORMAT>··[default:·json]·[possible·values:·json,·jsonl,·markdown,·table,·toon]
······--output·<OUTPUT>··
··-h,·--help·············Print·help
===·import·===
Add·the·records·of·one·scope·export·file·to·the·scope

Usage:·provenance·import·[OPTIONS]·--input·<INPUT>

Options:
······--quiet············Drop·the·advisory·notes·commands·print·alongside·their·output,·such·as·the·warning·that·this·repository·has·no·shaping·skills·installed
······--repo·<REPO>······[default:·.]
······--scope·<SCOPE>····[default:·default]
······--format·<FORMAT>··[possible·values:·json]
······--input·<INPUT>····The·scope·export·file·to·import:·the·JSON·document·that·export·writes.
······--dry-run··········Run·each·check·of·the·import·and·write·nothing.
··-h,·--help·············Print·help
===·swarm-backtrace-land·===
Add·the·results·of·one·swarm·backtrace·run·to·the·graph·as·proposals

Usage:·provenance·swarm-backtrace·land·[OPTIONS]·--run-dir·<RUN_DIR>

Options:
······--quiet··············Drop·the·advisory·notes·commands·print·alongside·their·output,·such·as·the·warning·that·this·repository·has·no·shaping·skills·installed
······--repo·<REPO>········[default:·.]
······--scope·<SCOPE>······[default:·default]
······--format·<FORMAT>····[possible·values:·json]
······--run-dir·<RUN_DIR>··The·swarm·run·directory:·its·extractors,·refuters,·contributions,·and·merge·output.
······--replace············Replace·the·generated·records·that·an·earlier·landing·of·this·run·wrote.
··-h,·--help···············Print·help
